# Rupkotha Travels (রূপকথা ট্রাভেলস) — Complete Knowledge Base & Services Spec

> Comprehensive operational, pricing, destination, and policy data for Rupkotha Travels, Kolkata's premier experiential tour operator and authorized government tourism booking agent for Eco Tour Odisha and Chhattisgarh Tourism.

---

## 1. Company Profile & Official Entity Information
- **Brand Name**: Rupkotha Travels (রূপকথা ট্রাভেলস)
- **Legal Registration & Entity**: Registered Tour Operator in West Bengal, India
- **Headquarters / Desk**: Kolkata Hub (Serving Howrah, Sealdah, Shalimar, Kolkata Terminal)
- **Official Credentials**: Authorized Booking Agent for Eco Tour Odisha & Chhattisgarh Tourism Board
- **Website**: https://rupkothatravels.com
- **Official Email**: booking@rupkothatravels.com
- **WhatsApp Concierge**: +91 98300 12345
- **Operating Hours**: Monday through Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:30 PM IST

---

## 2. Core Service Offerings & Fixed Departures (2026–2027)

### 2.1 Tadoba Tiger Reserve Wildlife Safari
- **Category**: Type 3 (Eco-Forest Safari)
- **Duration**: 5 Nights & 6 Days (3 Nights Moharli)
- **Departure Date**: 21st December 2026
- **Pricing**: Twin Sharing ₹20,900/- | Extra Adult ₹17,500/-
- **Inclusions**: 3 Core Safaris + 1 Buffer Safari, AC Jungle Resort, 4 daily meals, station transfers.

### 2.2 Rajasthan Grand Heritage
- **Category**: Type 1 (Cultural & Royal Heritage)
- **Duration**: 12 Nights & 13 Days
- **Route**: Jaipur (2N), Pushkar (1N), Udaipur (2N), Mount Abu (1N), Jodhpur (1N), Bikaner (1N), Jaisalmer (2N)
- **Departure Date**: 18th December 2026
- **Pricing**: Twin Sharing ₹29,900/- | Extra Adult ₹25,900/- | Child (6–11 yrs) ₹16,900/-
- **Inclusions**: Sleeper train tickets from Howrah, dedicated MUV fleet, all meals, fort tours, Sam Sand dunes camp.

### 2.3 Koraput & Bastar Tribal Circuit (Chitrakote & Jagdalpur)
- **Category**: Type 1 (Tribal Heritage & Eco-Tour)
- **Duration**: 7 Nights & 8 Days (Koraput 2N, Chitrakote 2N, Jagdalpur 1N)
- **Departure Dates**: 20th September 2026, 22nd November 2026
- **Pricing**: Twin Sharing ₹23,900/- | Extra Adult ₹19,900/- | Child (6–11 yrs) ₹13,900/-
- **Inclusions**: Sleeper train tickets from Howrah, Chitrakote Falls, Kanger Valley limestone caves, Deomali peak, Eco Tour Odisha facilitation.

### 2.4 Bastar Tribal Dussehra Festival
- **Category**: Type 1 (Tribal Festival)
- **Duration**: 7 Nights & 8 Days (Jagdalpur 3N, Chitrakote 2N)
- **Departure Date**: 18th October 2026 (Bastar Dussehra Festival)
- **Pricing**: Twin Sharing ₹24,500/- | Extra Adult ₹20,500/-
- **Inclusions**: 75-day World Famous Dussehra chariot rituals, Gond tribal arts, Tirathgarh waterfall.

### 2.5 Sandakphu Singalila Himalayan Ridge Trek
- **Category**: Type 2 (Himalayan Ridge Trek)
- **Duration**: 6 Nights & 7 Days
- **Route**: Manebhanjan (1N), Tumling (1N), Kalipokhri (1N), Sandakphu (2N), Srikhola (1N)
- **Departure Dates**: 14th November 2026, 10th April 2027
- **Pricing**: Twin Sharing ₹18,500/- | Extra Adult ₹16,200/-
- **Inclusions**: Vintage Land Rover 4x4 or guided trek, Singalila permits, Sleeping Buddha views (Everest & Kanchenjunga).

### 2.6 Spiti Valley Trans-Himalayan Road Trip
- **Category**: Type 2 (High-Altitude Expeditions)
- **Duration**: 9 Nights & 10 Days
- **Route**: Shimla (1N), Kalpa (1N), Kaza (3N), Chandratal (1N), Manali (2N)
- **Departure Dates**: 12th June 2026, 18th September 2026
- **Pricing**: Twin Sharing ₹31,900/- | Extra Adult ₹27,500/-
- **Inclusions**: Kunzum Pass, Chandratal Lake camping, Key Monastery, Komic (world's highest village), medical oxygen, experienced mountain drivers.

### 2.7 Hornbill Festival & Nagaland Tribal Odyssey
- **Category**: Type 1 (Tribal Festival & Cultural)
- **Duration**: 6 Nights & 7 Days (Dimapur 1N, Kohima 3N, Khonoma 1N)
- **Departure Date**: 1st December 2026
- **Pricing**: Twin Sharing ₹28,900/- | Extra Adult ₹24,900/-
- **Highlights**: Kisama Heritage Village Hornbill Festival, 16 Naga tribal dances, Khonoma Green Village.

### 2.8 Sundarbans Mangrove Delta Cruise
- **Category**: Type 3 (Mangrove Delta Safari)
- **Duration**: 2 Nights & 3 Days (Every Friday Departure)
- **Pricing**: Twin Sharing ₹8,500/- | Extra Adult ₹7,200/-
- **Highlights**: Motor launch cruise, Sajnekhali, Sudhanyakhali, Dobanki canopy walk, Royal Bengal tiger habitat.

## 3. Bespoke Private Circuits

### 3.1 Ladakh Tailored Expeditions (LAD 01 – LAD 08)
- Comprehensive MAP meal plan (Breakfast & Dinner), private Innova/Scorpio/Tempo, Leh acclimatization day, oxygen kits, Inner Line Permits.
- Key circuits include Pangong Tso, Nubra Valley sand dunes, Siachen Base Camp, Hanle Dark Sky Reserve, and Zanskar Valley.

### 3.2 Andaman Aqua Paradise (AND 01 – AND 05)
- Port Blair Cellular Jail, Havelock Island (Radhanagar Beach & Elephant Beach snorkeling), Neil Island (coral reefs & natural bridge), high-speed catamaran ferries (Makruzz/Green Ocean).

---

## 4. Operational Standards & Logistics

1. **Train Travel**: All fixed departures include Non-AC 3-Tier Sleeper train tickets from Sealdah / Howrah / Kolkata stations with luggage porter assistance. 3AC upgrades available.
2. **Ground Fleet**: Scorpio, Bolero, Innova, Xylo, 13-seater and 17-seater Tempo Travellers with mountain-trained drivers.
3. **Daily Catering**: 4 hot meals daily (Bed tea, breakfast, lunch, evening snacks & tea, dinner) with fresh local ingredients.
4. **Cancellation Terms**: 60+ days before departure: 10% deduction; 45–59 days: 30% deduction; 30–44 days: 40% deduction; 15–29 days: 60% deduction; <15 days: No refund.
